purpose: native fault42 anonymous-pipe capture transport fork with runner-19 drain semantics

transport.capture: direct pigz stdin ChildStdin passed as dynamic /dev/fd/N
transport.pre_exec: clear FD_CLOEXEC on actual owned descriptor via fcntl

protocol.positive_points_invalid_metadata: drain compressor, record statuses/hash/bytes, then reject
protocol.zero_or_missing_metadata: kill blocked compressor promptly and reject
protocol.receipt_failures: propagate stage-1 filesystem/hash errors; never claim receipt success
protocol.known_sandbox_probe: dynamic /dev/fd/N test is ignored locally because sandbox returns EPERM; approved environment must pass it
